7617.value:
==========BUGFIXES==========
- Players who leave the game once again have their towers cleared
- Arcane Sanctum challenge: Description incorrectly showed 10 minutes instead of 12 minutes as the completion time
- Ice Bolt should no longer visually show all damage it deals as a critical strike (visual only, did not actually do more damage)
- Splasher should no longer visually show splash damage it deals as a critical strike (visual only, did not actually do more damage)
- Lightning Generator should now always benefit from the Multifire bonus
- Overloaded Catapult should no longer visually show splash damage it deals as a critical strike (visual only, did not actually do more damage)
- Frost Armor should now freeze enemies if they hit the tower and reach 50 stacks of Frost, whereas before only Frost damage could actually freeze at 50 stacks
- Frost Armor now appears in the proper Upgrade button frame row (on the left)
- Ankh of Reconstruction: Fixed some issues when Ankh was triggered by negative health regeneration
- Golden Medallion: Fixed a few weird issues while updating the upgrade to stack more frequently

==========NERFS==========
- Critical Strike & Critical Decimation: Base critical strike damage 250%->200%
- Growing Blaze: No longer increases the damage of the Fire effect itself, only the original damage
- Bash: +20% damage to Stunned enemies -> +10% damage to Stunned enemies
- Orb of Power: +30% damage to Stunned enemies -> +15% damage to Stunned enemies
- Dazing Stuns: +50% Stun Duration -> +20% Stun Duration
- Spiky Armor: Now only stacks up to +50% damage per Spiky Armor upgrade
==========BUFFS==========
- All +Spikes Damage Upgrades: Now give 25% more +Spikes Damage than before
- Unbreakable Armor: Damage reduction cap 75% of incoming damage -> Removed
- Armor-Plated Spikes: +1 Armor per second -> +2 Armor per second
- Deflection: Damage reduction cap 75% of incoming damage -> Removed

9591.value:
===========CHANGES==========
- Income Upgrades: Chance to appear no longer higher for the initial shop each round, bad luck protection reworked and now works based on Income upgrades purchased, with more expensive Income upgrades valued more highly
- Enemies: If an enemy dies as it hits the Tower, the damage is set to 0 but it still counts as a hit
- Enemies: CC reduction was changed:
OLD: Increased by 2% per round, 4% per round after 10 minutes and 8% per round after 15 minutes, capped at 98%
NEW: Increases by 1% per round after 5 minutes, 3% per round after 10 minutes and 6% per round after 15 minutes, caps at 90%
- Weapons now only pick a new random target to attack 33% of the time when a new unit enters their attack range, this should help alleviate an issue where weapons will stutter at very high attack speeds before attacking their new target
- Impaler: Damage reduction debuff no longer classified as a Stun, damage rebalanced (damage dealt before was buggy) and now has a 5% chance to launch a free attack when the Tower is damaged
- Storm Generator: No longer activates at the start of every round, instead has a 30 second attack cooldown that's not reduced by +% Attack Speed, duration still scales with +% Attack Speed, this means it only activates if an enemy is in range
- Armor-Plated Spikes: Attacks from Gold Wagons no longer deplete bonus arrmor
- Reactive Armor: Attacks from Gold Wagons no longer grant bonus armor
- Living Wood: Heals 1500 health over 10 seconds-> Heals 1000 health over 5 seconds
- Black Markets & Duplicators: Twice as likely to appear in the shop
- Golden Medallion: +50% permanent bounty per 500 kills -> +10% permanent bounty per 100 kills
